career_ladder.note: Junior Engineers (JE) in Punjab State Power Corporation Limited (PSPCL) form the foundational technical supervisory cadre in power distribution, substation operations, transmission lines, and generation plants. Career advancement follows established statutory service regulations through departmental examinations, professional performance, and time-bound seniority promotions.

exam_scheme.note: The selection process for Junior Engineer in PSPCL is conducted via an objective Computer Based Online Test (CBT) consisting of 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks with a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes). The examination features 0.25 negative marking (1/4th mark deduction for each incorrect answer). Candidates must have passed Punjabi language up to Matriculation or its equivalent standard as a mandatory prerequisite.

stages.source_label: PSPCL Detailed Advt. No. CRA 303/24 (Section: Scheme of Examination & Selection Criteria)

papers.paper_name: CBT Objective Paper: Discipline Knowledge & General Aptitude
papers.negative_marking: 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer (1/4th negative marking; each question carries 1 mark)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Consists of 100 MCQs divided into four sections: Discipline Specific Technical Syllabus (Electrical/Substation/Civil Engineering - 70 Qs / 70 marks), General Knowledge / Awareness (10 Qs / 10 marks), Reasoning Ability (10 Qs / 10 marks), and General English (10 Qs / 10 marks). Minimum qualifying marks: 45% (45 marks) for General category and 35% (35 marks) for Reserved category candidates. Final selection is made strictly on merit of marks scored in CBT followed by document checking.

financial_package.note: Junior Engineers in PSPCL are placed in Level 6 of the revised pay structure per PSPCL Financial Circular No. 21/2022 dated 17.08.2022, aligned with the Punjab Pay Commission / 7th CPC Matrix (Pay Scale ₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400) with a minimum entry basic pay of ₹35,400. In accordance with Punjab Government Finance Department notification (Letter No. 7/42/2020-5FP1/741-746 dated 17.07.2020), candidates serve an initial probation period of 3 years during which they receive only the fixed 'minimum admissible pay' of ₹35,400 per month without DA, Grade Pay, annual increments, or allowances (except TA and medical reimbursement). Upon successful completion of probation, regular allowances including DA, HRA, and annual increments are drawn.
financial_package.pay_source_label: PSPCL Advt. No. CRA 303/24 & Financial Circular No. 21/2022
financial_package.estimate_note: Regular post-probation gross salary computed from Level 6 entry basic ₹35,400 + 58% Dearness Allowance (₹20,532) + House Rent Allowance (8% to 16% in Punjab: ₹2,832 to ₹5,664) + mobile, technical conveyance, and medical allowances. In-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions including 10% NPS/CPF contribution (Basic + DA = ₹5,593) and Punjab State Professional Tax (₹200). During the initial 3-year probation, newly appointed engineers receive fixed minimum admissible pay of ₹35,400 per month.
official_perks: Subsidized and free electricity units allowance per PSPCL employee electricity concession policy
Comprehensive medical treatment and hospitalization expense reimbursement for officer and family dependents
Contributory Provident Fund (CPF) / National Pension System (NPS) and statutory Death-cum-Retirement Gratuity
Technical conveyance allowance, official mobile recharge entitlement, and inspection travel reimbursement
Departmental residential quarters located in PSPCL thermal colonies, hydel power stations, or circle headquarters subject to availability
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and festival advance per PSPCL service regulations
